authority: User explicitly authorized acceptance revision and continued implementation through normal PR67 merge; 2026-09-15 current conversation.
objective: Preserve most historical earning capacity while measurably improving cross-AI robustness, holding/recovery and practical simplicity.

paired_robustness.universe_removal: tradable-only; historical and current native public backtest retain their own dated reference responsibilities. Never mix with all-role Absolute removals.
paired_robustness.primary_improvement: lower-quartile geometric wealth >=1.10 times historical, with p90 drawdown no more than historical+0.01; OR p90 drawdown improves >=0.02 with lower-quartile geometric wealth >=0.90 times historical
paired_robustness.cross_industry_rule: Both full-window public cases must remain profitable and retain at least 75% of historical wealth; their aggregate geometric wealth must retain at least 85%. These cases are not included in the 34-LOO lower-quartile metric.

operations: 44-order maximum applies to deployed nominal main account, not each hypothetical removal. All actual orders, annual turnover, costs and risk exits remain counted and disclosed; stress order outliers reviewed for practical burden, never relabeled.
correctness: no cost or data changes except registered cost stress
interpretation: All historical windows are selection data; neither repeated historical LOO nor forward backfill is out-of-sample proof. Missing required evidence is INCOMPLETE, never PASS. Frozen old gates remain separately reported.

rationale.wealth_budget: 15% aggregate terminal-wealth sacrifice is about 4.4% per-year growth-factor sacrifice over the 3.59-year full period; 25% cell guard catches concentrated destruction rather than requiring every cell to preserve 90%. Short-window loss remains separately visible. These are economic preferences chosen before the missing comparisons, not a statistical confidence claim.
rationale.generalization: Require an economically material 10% lower-tail improvement, or 2 percentage-point tail drawdown improvement with bounded wealth sacrifice. These are alternatives, not a demand that all metrics dominate.
rationale.orders: Preserve the actual nominal manual-operation budget. Stress portfolios are hypothetical alternative deployments, so their counts remain explicit review evidence rather than 34 simultaneous operation obligations.

definitions.wealth_retention: candidate net terminal wealth / historical net terminal wealth in the identical cell
definitions.performance_cells: Cartesian product of five frozen pools and all nine performance_windows; each of 45 cells has equal log-wealth weight. Overlapping windows are disclosed and are not independent samples.
definitions.intervals: Both endpoints inclusive; retain original July-1 overlap exactly.
definitions.percentiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p of ascending finite values, matching numpy.percentile(method=linear).
definitions.lower_quartile: Geometric mean of the 9 lowest terminal wealth values among the 34 public tradable-only LOO cases, computed separately for historical and candidate; no case selection after results.
definitions.positive: net terminal wealth strictly greater than 1.0
definitions.nonfinite: Nonfinite, nonpositive wealth or invalid account/source/date/data/runtime is INVALID. Missing required evidence is INCOMPLETE. Neither can PASS.
definitions.main: Full 34-stock public production account over canonical 869-session window. Also disclose each A-E continuous account.
definitions.stress: Each of full, remove308, remove502 uses public production backtest; 2x each of commission_rate,min_commission,stamp_duty,transfer_fee,slippage against same-source standard-cost offset0. Offset5/10 starts on the 6th/11th actual common index session after canonical start; same fixed end, own initial cash, causal warmup. Median and minimum retention are computed for each scenario separately vs its offset0 account; all three scenarios must satisfy bounds.
definitions.comparison_config: Each checkout uses its committed default config; shared economic cost/cash fields must match before standard comparisons. Schema/strategy differences are recorded, never patched into historical implementation.
